name: token-warn
description: Status entry with the session's running token total, plus toasts when it passes thresholds or one subagent or Workflow run uses a lot.

thresholds.title: Session thresholds
thresholds.description: Comma list of session totals to warn at (k and M suffixes allowed).

agentLimit.title: Subagent / Workflow limit
agentLimit.description: Warn when one subagent or Workflow run uses more tokens than this.
